description: React component for importing and converting notes to a custom 'Super' format, including UI elements, callbacks, and external component integrations.

classes.name: SuperNoteImporter
classes.description: React functional component for importing and converting notes to a Super note format.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the note content, updating lastValue state.

methods.name: performConvert
methods.description: Performs the conversion of note text and saves via NoteViewController.

methods.name: confirmConvert
methods.description: Confirms and executes the note conversion process.

methods.name: convertAsIs
methods.description: Converts the note as-is, with user confirmation, useful for returning to Super format.
